import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { interpolateArcRotateCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;
const MAX_SEG = Math.PI / 4; // each interpolation arc is shorter than π, so shortest-arc interpolation keeps growing alpha
const LIMIT_EPS = 1e-9;

type SavedAlphaLimits = { lower?: number; upper?: number };

function disableAlphaLimits(camera: ArcRotateCamera): SavedAlphaLimits {
  const saved = { lower: camera.lowerAlphaLimit, upper: camera.upperAlphaLimit };
  if (saved.lower !== undefined || saved.upper !== undefined) {
    camera.lowerAlphaLimit = undefined;
    camera.upperAlphaLimit = undefined;
  }
  return saved;
}

function restoreAlphaLimits(camera: ArcRotateCamera, saved: SavedAlphaLimits): void {
  if (saved.lower === undefined && saved.upper === undefined) return;
  const alpha = camera.alpha;
  const within = (saved.lower === undefined || alpha >= saved.lower - LIMIT_EPS) &&
                 (saved.upper === undefined || alpha <= saved.upper + LIMIT_EPS);
  if (within) {
    camera.lowerAlphaLimit = saved.lower;
    camera.upperAlphaLimit = saved.upper;
  }

export async function spinAround(camera: ArcRotateCamera, scene: SceneContext, turns: number): Promise<void> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(turns)) throw new RangeError("turns must be finite");
  const magnitude = Math.abs(turns);
  if (magnitude === 0) return;
  const totalDelta = magnitude * TWO_PI;
  const startAlpha = camera.alpha;

  const segmentCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalDelta / MAX_SEG));

  const saved = disableAlphaLimits(camera);

    for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
      const goal = i === segmentCount - 1 ? finalAlpha : startAlpha + (i + 1) * segmentDelta;
      await interpolateArcRotateCamera(camera, scene, { alpha: goal });
    }
  } finally {
    restoreAlphaLimits(camera, saved);
  }
}

import { interpolateArcRotateCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

const MAX_SEGMENT = Math.PI / 2;

interface SavedAlphaLimits {

function clearPendingMotion(camera: ArcRotateCamera): void {
  camera.inertialAlphaOffset = 0;
  camera.inertialBetaOffset = 0;
  camera.inertialRadiusOffset = 0;
  camera.inertialPanningX = 0;
  camera.inertialPanningY = 0;
}

function liftAlphaLimits(camera: ArcRotateCamera): SavedAlphaLimits {
  const saved: SavedAlphaLimits = {
    lower: camera.lowerAlphaLimit,
    upper: camera.upperAlphaLimit,
  };
  if (saved.lower !== undefined) delete camera.lowerAlphaLimit;
  if (saved.upper !== undefined) delete camera.upperAlphaLimit;
  return saved;
}

function restoreAlphaLimitsIfPossible(camera: ArcRotateCamera, saved: SavedAlphaLimits): void {
  if (saved.lower === undefined && saved.upper === undefined) return;
  const alpha = camera.alpha;
  const lowerOk = saved.lower === undefined || alpha >= saved.lower - LIMIT_EPS;
  const upperOk = saved.upper === undefined || alpha <= saved.upper + LIMIT_EPS;
  if (lowerOk && upperOk) {

    if (saved.upper !== undefined) camera.upperAlphaLimit = saved.upper;
  }
}

  if (!Number.isFinite(turns)) throw new RangeError("turns must be finite");
  if (!Number.isFinite(camera.alpha)) throw new RangeError("camera.alpha must be finite");

    camera.panningInertia = savedPanningInertia;

  if (!Number.isFinite(turns)) throw new RangeError("turns must be finite");
  if (!Number.isFinite(camera.alpha)) throw new RangeError("camera.alpha must be finite");

  if (!Number.isFinite(finalAlpha)) throw new RangeError("resulting alpha is not finite");
  if (finalAlpha === startAlpha) return;
  const segmentCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalDelta / MAX_SEGMENT - SEGMENT_ROUNDING_EPS));
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(segmentCount)) throw new RangeError("turns is too large");

  const savedInertia = camera.inertia;
  const savedPanningInertia = camera.panningInertia;

      const goal = i === segmentCount - 1 ? finalAlpha : startAlpha + (i + 1) * segmentDelta;

    clearPendingMotion(camera);
    camera.inertia = savedInertia;
    camera.panningInertia = savedPanningInertia;
    restoreAlphaLimitsIfPossible(camera, savedLimits);
  }
}
